answer: A farm dies on the first hurdle when the hurdle is Registered vat man pulp file with vat men certification, and the hurdle is 3-year training, 138 supervised makings, craft exam, annual re-assessment. Minutes add up the same way: 16 for one, 11664 for 729, and the farm pays in afternoons it never gets back. The trellis is the evidence, the atlas is the expense, and the vault is the expiry that forces the farm to pay again. One check, one price, one open book: the farm cannot afford the book.
